senses.gloss: [to sting, cmp. סְנֶה; of color:] to be bright, shine. V. סְנוּנִית.—Part. pass. סָנוּן; pl. סְנוּנִין.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> (expl. <he>מפזז</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 6:16">II Sam. VI, 16</cite>) <he>היה לבוש בגדי זהב ס׳ וכ׳</he> he was dressed in glistening, gold-embroidered garments shining like fine gold.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:2">Sabb. XX, 2</cite> <he>מְסַנְּנִין את היין וכ׳</he> you may (on the Sabbath) filter wine through a cloth &c.Ḥull.

Ḥull. 67ᵃ יבחושין שסִינְּנָן gnats in liquids which one has passed through a filter; a. e.—Part. pass. מְסוּנָּן refined, bright. Num. R. l. c. (expl. מפזז, v. supra) הזהב המס׳ … פוזז the refined gold which he wore made a rustling noise.

senses.gloss: to be refined. Ib. s. 7, beg. נִסְתַּנְּנוּ הפסולות ממנו וכ׳ when the base metals are removed from it (the silver) by refining, it shows at once &c.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 12:7">Ps. XII, 7</cite>) [read:] <he>כשם שהכסף … ומצטרף ומִסְתּוֹנֵן וכ׳</he> as the silver to be smelted enters the crucible and is smelted and refined etc.; <he>כך היא התורה מִסְתּוֹנֶנֶת וכ׳</he> so is the Law refined and smelted (through study) in forty-nine ways.
